purpose: Machine-readable API index for Ginject framework

core.responsibility: Application lifecycle, handler invocation, DI container

methods.name: New
methods.purpose: Create new app instance; request body cap defaults to DefaultMaxRequestBodyBytes

methods.name: Create
methods.purpose: Initialize app with module tree (MUST call exactly once, before Listen)

methods.name: Listen
methods.purpose: Log routes, then serve with graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown (30s drain)

methods.name: Stop
methods.purpose: Trigger the shutdown path (module OnShutdown hooks, once)

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.purpose: HTTP entry point; wraps r.Body in http.MaxBytesReader when the cap is > 0

methods.name: Get
methods.purpose: Resolve a constructed provider after Create

methods.name: UseLogger
methods.purpose: Install a logger; wrapped with field masking from LogOptions.MaskFields

methods.name: BindGlobalMiddlewares
methods.purpose: Register middlewares for all routes

methods.name: BindGlobalGuards
methods.purpose: Register guards for all routes

methods.name: BindGlobalInterceptors
methods.purpose: Register interceptors for all routes

methods.name: BindGlobalExceptionFilters
methods.purpose: Register exception filters for all routes

methods.name: EnableWS
methods.purpose: Enable WebSocket; middlewares run in the handshake and can reject the upgrade

methods.name: EnableVersioning
methods.purpose: Enable route versioning

methods.name: EnableAccessLog
methods.purpose: Subscribe the access logger to trace events

methods.name: EnableDevtool
methods.purpose: Build the devtool snapshot. Transport is NOT implemented; logs WSNotServed-style warning DevtoolNotServed

methods.name: SetMaxRequestBodySize
methods.purpose: Cap request bodies. 0 or less disables. NOTE: earlier versions of this index listed a SetMaxBodySize method that never existed

Module.description: Composition root for controllers and providers, with lifecycle hooks
exported_fields: Name string            // resolved by resolveModuleName at Build(); empty in -trimpath builds
IsGlobal bool          // promote this module's providers to the global registry
OnInit func()          // runs DURING graph construction, BEFORE children and providers exist
OnReady func()         // runs at the end of app.Create, after everything is wired
OnShutdown func()      // runs on SIGINT/SIGTERM or app.Stop(), once via sync.Once
Module.unexported_fields: id, prefixes, singleInstance, staticModules []*Module, dynamicModules []any, providers, controllers
Module.correction: earlier versions listed "imports []*Module", "WSHandlers []WSHandler" and "HTTPMainHandlers []HTTPMainHandler". Real names: staticModules/dynamicModules, WSMainHandlers []common.WSLayer, HTTPMainHandlers []common.HTTPLayer

ModuleBuilder.description: Fluent builder returned by core.ModuleBuilder(). Unexported type (*moduleBuilder) - only these four methods exist
ModuleBuilder.correction: earlier versions of this index listed Export(...) and IsGlobal(bool) builder methods. Neither exists. IsGlobal is a FIELD on *Module, set after Build(): m := ...Build(); m.IsGlobal = true

WSConfig.description: WebSocket transport configuration passed to App.EnableWS

fields.name: MaxPayloadBytes
fields.purpose: Per-frame cap; 0 uses DefaultWSMaxPayloadBytes (1MB). x/net default would be 32MB

fields.name: AllowedOrigins
fields.purpose: When non-empty, handshake rejects unlisted Origin. Absent Origin is allowed (non-browser client). Trailing / trimmed

WSConnmgr.description: Per-app WebSocket connection registry and broker bridge

methods.name: Register
methods.purpose: Add connection and start its write pump. Returns nil past MaxConnections or on duplicate connID - callers MUST nil-check and close the socket

methods.name: Unregister
methods.purpose: Close done, drop subscriptions, unsubscribe from broker. Safe to call twice

methods.name: Get
methods.purpose: Look up a live connection

methods.name: Count
methods.purpose: Live connection count

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.signature: Subscribe(connID, topic string, handler memorybroker.MessageHandler) error
methods.purpose: Subscribe a connection to a topic

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.purpose: Remove one topic subscription

ctx.responsibility: Request context objects and dependency types

common.responsibility: Pipeline interfaces and embedded controller types

interfaces.Logger: interface { Log(level string, data any); LogStructured(...) }
interfaces.Publisher: interface { Publish(topic string, data any) error }

embedded_types.REST: Embed in controller to enable HTTP routing
embedded_types.WS: Embed in controller to enable WebSocket routing

memorybroker.responsibility: Lightweight in-process topic-based pub/sub broker (no queue groups, no persistence, no ack/retry)

Message.description: Published message (no ID, no Metadata — removed in simplification)
fields: Timestamp time.Time - captured via time.Now() before dispatch

pattern_types: Exact: 'user.login' - O(1) map lookup, matches only that topic
Suffix: 'user.*' - O(1) map lookup by prefix; greedy, matches ANY depth below 'user.', not just one level
Global: '*' - O(1), matches all topics. '*' is the ONLY wildcard token; '>' is NOT special-cased (verified empirically) - a pattern containing '>' matches only that literal string
Complex: 'user.*.profile', '*.created' - O(n) scan; segment-wildcard matching, NOT regex
key_features: Single sync.RWMutex over 4 maps (exact/prefix/global/complex) - no sharding
PublishAsync: one goroutine per call tracked by sync.WaitGroup, no worker pool/bounded queue
Close(): CompareAndSwap-idempotent, waits for in-flight PublishAsync via WaitGroup, then clears all maps
Cross-broker Unsubscribe protection via ErrForeignSubscription (checks subscription.broker == receiver)
Unsubscribe(nil) is always nil, unconditionally, even after Close
Unconditional panic recovery per handler call (not configurable, no OnPanic hook)
publishInternal sizes handler slice exactly, skips allocation entirely when nothing matches

options.name: WithPanicHandler
options.purpose: Observe panics escaping a subscriber. Default reports to stderr; handlers are isolated either way

constructor.name: NewMemoryBroker
constructor.purpose: Variadic options; existing no-arg calls unchanged

memorycache.responsibility: Sharded in-memory TTL cache with a bounded entry count. Memory-only - no persistence.

MemoryCache.description: In-memory cache with sharded architecture and persistence
methods: Set(ctx, key string, val []byte, ttl time.Duration) error
SetNX(ctx, key string, val []byte, ttl time.Duration) (bool, error)

options.name: WithMaxEntries
options.purpose: Total entry cap across shards; 0 or less means unlimited

memorycache.lifecycle: Stop() halts the sweeper and is idempotent (sync.Once). modules/cache.Register wires it to module.OnShutdown only for a backend it created.
memorycache.no_persistence: memory-only. PersistenceConfig / NewMemoryCacheWithConfig were documented by earlier revisions of this index but never existed in the code (verified with git log -S). Eviction is TTL + sampled, not LFU.
memorycache.eviction: TTL-based: expired entries first, then the sampled entry closest to expiry (evictSampleSize=8). NOT LFU - no access-frequency tracking exists.

critical_rules: NEVER hold onto context after request completes
NEVER mutate context after guard stage
NEVER panic in guard (return bool instead)
NEVER call next() multiple times in middleware
NEVER access raw websocket.Conn in handlers (use Publisher)
NEVER retain pooled objects beyond request lifetime
Module initialization order is SACRED - do not reorder
common_mistakes: Type mismatch between provider and handler parameter
Calling next() multiple times in middleware
Slow clients causing message drops in WebSocket
